hypothesis: The pooled traces show that labeled demonstrations improve aggregate accuracy over a bare prompt, while the full demonstration context averages about 8,100 characters. Ranking a small, label-diverse subset by rare-token similarity should retain useful evidence at lower context; this is falsified if evaluation accuracy falls below the full-example baseline or context is not materially shorter.

Compact per-label discriminative terms plus a representative example should preserve category distinctions with less context than storing every demonstration; this is falsified if aggregate accuracy drops without a meaningful context reduction.

Retrieving only previously incorrect cases with their corrected labels should guide similar future problems more effectively than unguided prompting; this is falsified if aggregate accuracy does not exceed the no-memory baseline.

Blending cosine and BM25 relevance, then reducing near-duplicate neighbors under a label cap, will improve on the current IDF top-k system at comparable context length; aggregate accuracy and context length can falsify this claim.

Smoothed label-specific token evidence with a minimum repeated-example support threshold will provide a more reliable compact category comparison than one medoid and a short signature; aggregate accuracy and context length test the claim.

Retrieving successful labeled cases alongside explicit wrong-answer/correct-label contrasts will outperform error-only correction memory by preserving positive evidence when few similar corrections exist; aggregate accuracy and context length test the claim.

Aggregating the strongest lexical similarities within each label, with a smaller confirmation contribution from a second case, will exceed IDF retrieval's 83.3% aggregate accuracy while keeping the displayed evidence compact; the controller can falsify this by comparing validation accuracy and context length.

Showing one phrase-aware nearest anchor per competing label together with query-specific overlapping and separating terms will improve on the hybrid system's 83.3% aggregate accuracy by clarifying close alternatives; validation accuracy is the falsifying measurement.

Deriving contrast cues from verified mistakes and applying each correction only when its cues match the new input will improve on outcome contrast memory's 80.0% aggregate accuracy without letting unrelated errors dominate; validation accuracy and context length can falsify this claim.

On pooled validation traces, phrase-aware retrieval that rewards coverage of distinctive query details will exceed the 83.3% aggregate accuracy of the strongest prior systems while keeping retrieved context compact; this is falsified if accuracy does not improve or context expands substantially.

Label profiles that show query-matched positive terms alongside terms characteristic of competing labels will outperform the 70.0% aggregate score of the prior likelihood-profile approach by grounding lexical contrasts in verified examples; this is falsified if aggregate accuracy remains at or below that level.

Error rules conditioned on a specific predicted-label to corrected-label pair and discriminative trigger overlap will improve on the 83.3% aggregate score of cue-conditioned correction without letting unrelated feedback dominate; this is falsified if aggregate accuracy fails to increase.

If independent single cues are noisy, requiring two co-occurring query details before applying a direction-specific correction rule will improve accuracy over the current pairwise error-rule system; this is falsified if the candidate does not exceed its 86.7% aggregate validation accuracy.

If difficult cases have closer competing label support, adapting the number of retrieved examples to the top-label support margin will improve accuracy over fixed-budget phrase retrieval; this is falsified if it does not exceed the 83.3% aggregate accuracy of phrase_coverage_memory.

If label distinctions depend on combinations of details, label-specific co-occurring phrase-pair cards will outperform the 80.0% aggregate accuracy of contrastive_label_profile; this is falsified if validation accuracy is at or below that baseline.

If some errors reflect qualified or wrapped answers despite an allowed label appearing in the response, retrieving nearby examples and canonicalizing against labels listed in the current prompt will improve on ambiguity_budgeted_retrieval with only a small context increase.
